description: Defines the Simulator class for scheduling and managing actors in a QUIC protocol simulation environment, including methods for running simulations until certain conditions or timeouts.

classes.name: Simulator
classes.description: Manages scheduling of actors in a network simulation, providing utilities like clock, alarms, and random number generation.

classes.name: Simulator::Clock
classes.description: Provides simulated clock functionalities for the Simulator.

classes.name: Simulator::RunForDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class used for the RunFor() method to handle alarms.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules an actor to run at a specified simulation time.

methods.name: Unschedule
methods.description: Removes an actor from the schedule.

methods.name: GetRandomGenerator
methods.description: Returns the random number generator used in the simulation.

methods.name: GetStreamSendBufferAllocator
methods.description: Returns the buffer allocator for stream sending.

methods.name: GetAlarmFactory
methods.description: Returns the alarm factory used for creating alarms.

methods.name: RunUntil
methods.description: Runs the simulation until a predicate returns true or the schedule is empty.

methods.name: RunUntilOrTimeout
methods.description: Runs the simulation until a predicate returns true or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: RunFor
methods.description: Runs the simulation for a specified duration.
